sipher.welcome.title: Welcome to Sipher
sipher.welcome.text: Sipher turns voice chat into live captions for you and the players who can hear you. Speech recognition runs on your own computer: your voice never leaves it.
sipher.welcome.language.tooltip: The language you speak and want to read captions in. You can choose them separately later under Languages.
sipher.welcome.share.tooltip: Sends your captions to players who can hear you on voice chat, when the server has Sipher. Server mods can receive them too. Your voice itself never leaves your computer.
sipher.welcome.built_in: English is built in: no download needed.
sipher.welcome.footer: Change this any time in Sipher's settings (press %s).
